subject: [hw] T01 -> V03: loader used by 97-kernel differential set, 0 unresolved, all symbols found
body: Thanks, V03 is exactly what I needed. tests/emu/diffrun.c creates n2a32_mem, n2elf_set, adds the two __aeabi_*divmod host shims, loads libsupport.so then libkernels.so, n2elf_link -> unresolved=0, n2elf_sym finds all 97 k_* names, and n2a32_call drives them. Verified with your test_v03 stub first (291/291 lines, no MISSING/STOP) and with the real core for arm-O0. No accessor needed: no bounds check beyond what n2a32 memory already does. The only thing I hit was the loader needing the real n2a32_mem (your stub is correctly not used by my harness). Once V02s route fix lands, run_diff.sh will produce the final table through your loader.
